name: beautiful-go
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic Go: three skills distilled from Effective Go, the Go Code Review Comments wiki, the Google Go Style Guide, Go Concurrency Patterns, and the facta backend-go handbook, plus a drop-in golangci-lint v2 config with the depguard architecture law.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for Go developers, distilled from Effective Go, the Go Code Review Comments wiki, the Google Go Style Guide, Go Concurrency Patterns, and the facta backend-go handbook.

go-best-practices guides new Go code: errors as values, context propagation, goroutine ownership, table-driven tests, and the hexagonal, vertical-slice architecture contract enforced by the bundled golangci-lint config.

go-review reviews a file, package, slice, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

go-port ports C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, or Rust to idiomatic Go with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md that lists every deliberate difference.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Go toolchain is available, the skills run gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, and go test on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in golangci-lint v2 config with the depguard architecture law is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review Go code with cited rules
Port code to Go with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this Go module and list what to fix first
Port this Python module to idiomatic Go
Write a Go handler for this endpoint under the hexagonal rules

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three skills distilled from five Go sources, plus a drop-in golangci-lint config whose depguard rules enforce the architecture.
